description: ClaimService defines operations for submitting and processing insurance claims, including submitting new claims, updating claim status, and retrieving claims by reference or customer.

classes.name: ClaimService
classes.description: Public interface that declares methods for managing insurance claims, such as submitting claims, updating their status, and retrieving claims based on reference or customer.

methods.name: submitClaim
methods.description: Submits a new insurance claim with specified details such as policy id, user id, customer id, claim amount, and description.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing claim, recording the change along with the actor user id and optional notes.

methods.name: findByReference
methods.description: Retrieves a claim based on a unique string reference, returning an Optional to handle the case where the claim may not be found.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Lists all claims associated with a particular customer, identified by customer ID.
